ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels and 55% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity white triangular patches centrally located on each lobe, bordered by low-intensity black margins at the trailing edge, leading edge, and a central vertical pillar at the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations along the continuous trailing edge; significant irregular peaks and valleys concentrated on the distal half of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the superior trailing edge, tapering to irregular points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacles) distributed along the outer margins and trailing edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical, low-intensity linear marks (rake marks) visible within the central dark-pigmented region and overlapping the inner white patches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular tissue erosion and scarring visible on the far left and far right distal tips of the fluke.
